target: Vim 9 at the exact sources.lock.json revision; eventual complete language and editor compatibility

scope.modern: All tracked src/testdir/test_*.vim files, including editor/legacy Vimscript tests
scope.legacy: All tracked src/testdir/test*.in inputs; separate legacy runner adapter required

whole_test_credit: Only a registered original-runner adapter with matching preparation, SetUp/TearDown, full body, all applicable observables, current fingerprints and a successful reference result may establish full-test equivalence.
unknowns: Lexical declarations are candidates, not an executed-test denominator. A skipped/failed discovery or legacy input remains denominator debt. Skips never earn conformance credit.
claim: Even 100% of a fixed test corpus/profile is empirical test conformance, not a proof of universal observational equivalence. Cross-platform and optional-feature profiles remain separate obligations.
